review_candidates.description: About STYL Solutions Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with an R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software, and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry. Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific. Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living. Job Description We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our engineering team, responsible for improving system reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency across our platform. This role focuses on engineering solutions to prevent incidents and improve long-term system reliability , rather than only reacting to operational issues. You will work closely with L2 Support, DevSecOps, and development teams to analyze production issues, eliminate recurring problems, and enhance system resilience in a distributed, cloud-based environment . You will play a key role in transforming operational insights into long-term improvements, automation, and reliability engineering practices . Responsibilities Your key responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Reliability Engineering & System Improvement Design and implement solutions to improve system reliability, availability, and performance Identify and eliminate recurring incidents and systemic bottlenecks Define and track service level indicators (SLIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) Root Cause Analysis & Problem Management Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major and recurring incidents Identify systemic issues and define long-term corrective actions Ensure RCA outcomes are translated into engineering improvements Observability & Monitoring Design and enhance monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks Build dashboards and metrics to provide visibility into system health Analyze system performance (latency, throughput, resource usage) Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities Contribute to capacity planning and scaling strategies Automation & Operational Efficiency Develop and maintenance automation to reduce manual operational effort and improve recovery time (e.g., self-healing, auto-remediation) Continuously optimize operational processes Qualifications We are looking for candidates who demonstrate: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 6 years experience or more in SRE or Production Engineering roles Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across distributed systems Experience with: Linux systems Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure) Microservices architecture Monitoring and observability tools CI/CD pipelines Strong understanding of: System design and failure scenarios Distributed system behavior (timeouts, retries, cascading failures) Good communication skills in English Technical skills Scripting/programming (Python, Bash, or similar) Experience with container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) Familiarity with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) Understanding of networking fundamentals Nice-to-have Experience with high-availability or high-transaction systems (e.g., fintech, payments) Familiarity with: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) Chaos engineering or resilience testing Knowledge of security best practices in cloud environments Success in this role looks like System reliability and availability improve over time Recurring incidents are significantly reduced MTTR decreases due to automation and improved processes Monitoring becomes more accurate with fewer false alerts Production releases become safer and more predictable Benefits STYL Solutions will give you the favorable conditions you need to tackle difficult problems and learn cutting-edge technologies: An international working environment with friendly and passionate colleagues Onsite opportunity to Japan, and Singapore for training and supporting customer Meaningful work with experienced & strong technical veterans Flat structure, simple processes & transparency In addition to providing you with professional growth, STYL Solutions is also committed to taking care of our employees, personally. As a full-time employee, you are automatically enrolled in our benefits program, which includes: Attractive compensation, regular assessments, and salary reviews 19 paid days off per year 100% salary & full social insurance during the probation period Premium health care insurance Free coffee, tea, and parking. Special celebration on 8/3, 1/6, Xmas, Tet holiday… Outing/team-building activities (trip, sport, dinner…) If you are ready to catapult your career to the next level, we will get you there. Please send all applications and CVs to our hiring team – hiring@styl.solutions. We look forward to working together and positioning STYL Solutions as an industry leader!

Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? You will leverage Oracle Exadata capabilities to ensure high performance, availability, and operational excellence while contributing to the evolution of our data platforms and automation capabilities. Your day to day Perform SQL tuning and performance optimization on large-scale Data Warehouse databases; Develop and maintain PL/SQL components, including stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers; Manage and maintain Oracle 19c/21c databases deployed on Oracle Exadata platforms; Monitor and optimize database and platform performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, execution plan analysis, and Exadata-specific features; Diagnose and resolve complex issues spanning databases, storage cells, networking, and cluster environments; Leverage Exadata capabilities such as Smart Scan, Smart Flash Cache, Storage Indexes, Hybrid Columnar Compression, and IORM to maximize platform performance; Collaborate with engineering and application teams to investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions; Automate operational processes using Bash, Python, Ansible, or similar technologies; Contribute to platform standards, operational procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing initiatives; Support security, compliance, and operational risk management requirements; Contribute to the modernization of data platforms through automation, engineering best practices, and cloud-ready solutions. What you’ll bring to the team Experience : 5+ years of Oracle Database Administration experience in enterprise environments; 3+ years of hands-on Oracle Exadata experience supporting production workloads; Tech stack/ knowledge: Mandatory : Strong proficiency in PL/SQL development, including stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers; Proven experience with SQL performance tuning on large-scale Data Warehouse databases and execution plan analysis; Experience using AWR, ASH, and ADDM for diagnostics and performance optimization; Hands-on scripting and automation skills using Bash, Python, Ansible, or similar tools; Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work effectively in complex technical environments; Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; Good understanding of Linux or other Unix-based operating systems; Ability to translate both functional and non-functional requirements into scalable technical solutions. Nice to have: Experience with Oracle Exadata Cloud Service (ExaCS) or Exadata Cloud@Customer (ExaCC); Experience with ETL/ELT tools, preferably IBM DataStage; Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Oracle Enterprise Manager,, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms. Experience supporting high-throughput, low-latency, or large-scale enterprise database environments; Oracle certifications related to Database Administration or Exadata; Experience with cloud data platforms is considered a strong advantage; willingness to grow towards cloud engineering and platform automation is expected. Foreign languages: Excellent written and spoken English; Education : nice to have bachelor’s degree (or higher) in an IT related field. About the Role As the ITS Works Monitoring Officer, you will monitor the road network and contract assets, receives and triages faults and incidents, and coordinates an appropriate operational response. The role applies judgement to classify and prioritise events, supports safe and reliable network operations, and maintains complete and accurate records that form part of the contract performance and audit evidence. The role operates within a 24/7 control room environment and works closely with Service Stream business units, the Department of Transport and Planning (DTP), including the Transport Operations Centre (TOC), delivery partners and emergency response stakeholders. Key responsibilities include: Monitor network conditions, incoming notifications, alarms, calls and available CCTV or system feeds in accordance with approved procedures. Triage, classify and prioritise faults, incidents and hazards by considering safety, network impact, service risk, contractual response requirements and available information. Escalate critical, ambiguous or deteriorating events promptly and apply the relevant incident, emergency and jeopardy management protocols. Initiate and coordinate the appropriate response, including dispatching or notifying internal teams, maintainers, subcontractors and other nominated resources. Maintain situational awareness and ownership of faults and incidents through to handover, resolution or formal closure. Liaise with provide timely and accurate updates to DTP, including the TOC, and other authorised stakeholders. Monitor and support faults affecting traffic signals and the range of intelligent transport system devices and other assets identified in the current VIMC contract asset schedule. Apply approved operating procedures and asset-specific response requirements, recognising that the contract asset schedule may change over time. Create clear, concurrent, and complete fault and incident records, including the information received, triage decision, classification, priority, actions, communications, timestamps, escalation and outcome. Maintain records as formal evidence of contract performance and compliance, suitable for client review, assurance activities and audit. Complete shift logs, handovers and required operational reports, and identify incomplete, inconsistent or overdue records for correction or escalation. Present fit for work, comply with fatigue management requirements, use rostered breaks and raise fatigue concerns or fitness-for-work issues promptly. Complete effective shift handovers so that operational risks, active events and required follow-up are understood by the incoming operator. About You Our ideal candidate will have experience in a control room, network operations, incident coordination, transport, utilities, telecommunications, logistics or another time-critical operational environment is desirable. You may also have: Experience managing competing priorities, coordinating responses and maintaining accurate operational records is desirable. Exposure to road networks, traffic operations or intelligent transport systems is advantageous. High attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, defensible and auditable records. Clear written and verbal communication, including during serious incidents and under time pressure. Ability to learn and confidently use control room, fault management, communications, CCTV, Microsoft 365 systems, SCATS, STREAMS, JAMS, NMS, Security Centre and RAI. Ability to work independently within delegated authority, follow procedures, escalate appropriately and maintain effective handovers. Ability to work safely, complete effective shift handovers, and apply fatigue management requirements on a rotating 24/7 shift roster. Relevant transport, operations, customer service, emergency management, technology or civil infrastructure qualifications are desirable but not essential where equivalent capability can be demonstrated. About Us Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries - we keep communities connected. Access - discounts for hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing and a share matching program. Paid leave - parental, cultural, community service, defence, study, corporate volunteering and purchased leave available. Culture – we are dedicated to fostering a workplace environment that values safety, diversity and inclusion, and meaningful recognition. How to Apply Please submit your interest with the apply button where you will be directed to create a profile and apply via our system Workday. Applications may be reviewed as received, so please don’t hesitate to apply! We celebrate diversity at Service Stream and welcome applications from people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, people with a disability or neurodivergence, and those from LGBTIQA+, Veteran or other diverse groups. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please email talent.transport@servicestream.com.au.

CRMプラットフォーム運用 • CRMサイト、アプリ、LINEなどのコミュニケーション基盤の運用 • ITチームおよび外部ベンダーとの連携による機能改善・運用最適化 • セグメント管理、配信設定、業務フロー管理 • CRM関連ガイドラインやマニュアルの整備・更新 7. 顧客データ分析・レポーティング • 顧客データを活用したセグメンテーションおよびターゲティング • CRM施策や会員向けキャンペーンの成果分析 • KPIモニタリングと共に、結果の背景要因を分析し、継続的な改善提案を行う • 顧客インサイトの抽出と関係部署への共有 8. 予算・オペレーション管理 • CRM施策に関わる予算管理サポート • 発注書（PO）発行および請求処理 • 外部パートナーとの運営管理 • コールセンターなど関連部署との連携 その他 • 国内出張あり（年1〜2回程度） • 必要に応じて店舗・イベント会場での業務対応あり Who You Are: 必須要件 • CRM、ロイヤルティマーケティング、ダイレクトマーケティング、メールマーケティング、またはデジタルマーケティング領 域における実務経験（5年以上） • 顧客データを活用したマーケティング施策の企画・運用経験 • メール、LINE、アプリ等を活用した顧客コミュニケーション施策の実務経験 • コンテンツ企画またはクリエイティブディレクション経験 • データ分析およびレポーティング経験 • プロジェクトマネジメントおよび関係者調整経験 • 日本語および英語による高いコミュニケーション能力（TOEIC 800点以上目安） • 学士号以上 歓迎要件 • 小売業界、ファッション業界、ライフスタイルブランドでのマーケティング経験 • CRMツール、CDP、マーケティングオートメーションツールの利用経験 • LINE公式アカウント運用経験 • モバイルアプリマーケティング経験 • Google Analytics 等を活用した分析経験 • ロイヤルティプログラム運営経験 • EC事業におけるCRMまたはデジタルマーケティング経験 求める人物像 • 顧客の気持ちや行動を深く理解しようとする高い顧客志向を持つ方 • 顧客データやインサイトを活用しながら効果的なコミュニケーションを設計できる方 • データとクリエイティブの両面からマーケティングを考えられる方 • 自ら課題を発見し、主体的に行動できる方 • 複数のプロジェクトを同時に推進できる高い実行力を持つ方 • 部門横断で信頼関係を構築し、協働できる方 • 新しいテクノロジーやマーケティング手法への学習意欲が高い方 • 仮説構築、検証、改善（Try → Learn → Improve）を繰り返しながら成果向上を目指せる方

review_candidates.title: 财务经理
review_candidates.description: 职位描述 （1）岗位要求: ◆ 性别: 不限 ◆ 年龄: 不限 ◆ 财务相关专业本科及以上学历,具备会计师中级及以上职称,掌握会计核算电算化工作 熟悉 SAGE PASTEL财务软件者优先。 ◆ 五年以上建筑工程公司财务工作经验,三年以上建筑工程公司财务经理工作经验,有海外 财务管理经验优先； ◆ 本科及以上学历，财务、会计、金融等相关专业背景优先考虑； ◆ 具备财务管理、审计、税务等相关专业证书或资格优先； ◆ 英语基础良好，大学英语四级以上，大学英语六级优先录用； ◆ 身体健康，能长期在国外工作； ◆ 良好的组织、协调、沟通能力和团队协作精神,能承受较大工作压力； （2）岗位职责： 1、审核和监督财务部的日常收付款基础工作,保证资金安全。 2、组织制定财务管理制度以及内控流程等有关规定,并监督执行。 3、组织制定年度财务部门计划,并有效实施、总结和反馈。 4、负责编制公司财务月度、年度公司资金预算报告并分析预算和执行差异。 5、全面负责各项目实际发生业务会计核算以及成本分析工作,按月出具内部财务报告。 6、积极有效的独立配合审计公司财报审计以及税务审计工作。

review_candidates.description: Position: Work from Home - Sales & Operations Coordinator Company: The Men’s Cave (IG: @themenscave) | themenscave.sg Location: Remote || Work from Home Schedule: Monday - Friday || 9:30 am - 6:30 pm (SGT) Salary Starts at: PHP 25,000 || IDR 7,000,000 (per month) Employment Type: Full-Time We're Hiring! Join The Men's Cave, a leader in the games room industry, and be part of a team that creates unforgettable experiences! We’re hiring a Work from Home - Sales & Operations Coordinator with a strong interest in sales support, customer service, order processing, and operational coordination. T his role is ideal for someone who enjoys collaborating with teams and helping drive business growth. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work setup or work-from-home arrangement in a company that values growth and promotes collaboration, wherever you are. About the Role The Work from home - Sales & Operations Coordinator will help in driving sales, customer engagement, and order management for Men’s Cave. You will handle inbound inquiries, qualify leads, present products, process and verify orders, coordinate with the delivery team, and maintain accurate CRM records. This role also includes reporting on sales and order status, flagging issues proactively, and supporting the team with administrative tasks. The ideal candidate is organized, customer-focused, and results-driven, helping ensure a seamless customer experience and smooth operations—all in a fully remote, 100% work-from-home environment that offers flexibility and autonomy to deliver exceptional results from anywhere. Key Responsibilities: Sales & Customer Engagement  Respond promptly and professionally to all inbound enquiries via phone, email, and chat Qualify leads, understand customer needs, and present Men's Cave products confidently Handle objections, guide customers toward a decision, and close deals Follow up consistently on open leads to maximize conversion Maintain a positive and premium customer experience at every touchpoint  Operations & Order Management Process and verify all closed orders ensuring pricing, specifications, and customer details are accurate Issue invoices, process deposits, and maintain accurate sales documentation  Act as the internal link between the sales team and delivery team to ensure orders are fulfilled correctly and on time  Communicate order details clearly during handoff to avoid fulfillment errors  Maintain and update the CRM with accurate customer profiles, deal stages, and interaction history  Reporting & Team Support Compile and submit weekly pipeline and order status reports to the Sales Lead Flag any operational bottlenecks, customer concerns, or delays proactively  Support the broader sales team with administrative tasks as needed Skills: Average to excellent communication skills (both verbal and written in English) Proficiency in CRM systems Inbound Sales & Administration Customer Engagement Order Processing Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Administration, Marketing or any related field Minimum 2 years of experience in sales and operations Experience in inbound sales and customer service is highly preferred Experience in processing and verifying sales orders is desirable Why Join Us? Work remotely with a supportive team. Receive performance-based incentives. Take ownership and directly impact team culture. Long-term role with a clear development path for remote employees. Ready to level up your career? Apply today!

review_candidates.title: Vice President of Investment
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Vice President - Investments Sector: Private Equity & Private Credit Investment Platform Coverage: Sustainable Infrastructure & Energy Location: New York City Summary: Talisman have been retained by a leading investment platform focused on private equity and private credit investments in middle-market sustainable infrastructure businesses. The team brings deep experience across project development, structured finance, and operations to support first-class management teams through periods of growth and transformation. The platform manages hundreds of millions of dollars across several funds and strategies, boasting a successful investment track record across a broad range of renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure technologies to date. Areas of focus have included include solar power, battery storage, hydroelectric generation, energy efficiency, electrified transport, and sustainable fuels. Job Summary: The fund is seeking a Vice President to join the investment team in New York City. The role offers exposure to all facets of the investment process, including sourcing, structuring, due diligence, financial analysis, and legal documentation. The Vice President will play a senior role within the investment team, leading the execution of new investments from screening through closing and supporting portfolio companies through value creation and exit. The position includes meaningful origination responsibility, direct interaction with management teams and the investment committee, and oversight of junior investment professionals. This is an opportunity to join a growing investment platform with significant momentum in the energy transition and sustainable infrastructure sectors. Key Responsibilities: Lead due diligence workstreams across commercial, financial, technical, legal, and tax topics, including management of external advisors Structure and negotiate transactions, including term sheets and definitive documentation Build, review, and pressure-test complex financial models and underwriting analyses Prepare investment memoranda and present opportunities to senior leadership and the investment committee Serve as a key relationship lead for portfolio companies, including performance monitoring and strategic engagement with management teams Support value creation initiatives, capital markets activities, and operational improvement programs Lead acquisition, merger, and exit processes at both the asset and corporate levels Support fundraising and investor relations activities, including preparation of materials and participation in LP diligence sessions Mentor and manage junior investment professionals Maintain valuation models and support quarterly portfolio reporting Coordinate with external counsel, lenders, fund administrators, and other counterparties Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier accredited university 5-7 years of experience in private equity, investment banking, infrastructure investing, renewable energy development, and/or project finance Strong experience within real assets, infrastructure, power, or renewable energy Demonstrated transaction experience across origination, structuring, diligence, negotiation, execution, and portfolio management Experience managing junior team members and external advisors Advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities Strong understanding of legal and commercial documentation Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills Intellectual curiosity, entrepreneurial mindset, and passion for the energy transition Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment Compensation: Highly competitive salary + bonus package Meaningful carry pool participation Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance. 401(k) plan with company match. Opportunities for career advancement within a best in class investment platform. How to apply: Apply below, or speak to the partner leading this search tom.perkin@talismanap.com
